# Hoog Law
> Business law and estate planning attorney in Longmont, Colorado. Michael Hoog handles entity formation, operating agreements, commercial contracts, AI governance and compliance, business succession, outside general counsel, wills, revocable living trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, irrevocable trusts, trust administration, and special needs trusts. Serving Longmont, Boulder, and the Colorado Front Range since 1995.
